history.summary: Strong fundamentals on paper — D14 RCR location 500m from Dakota MRT, $1,795 psf is ~16% under the $2,144 URA median, low $1.35M entry. But field reviews flag Paya Lebar Airbase military-jet noise and reportedly poor inter-floor insulation/cracking, which cap the verdict. A location-led Neutral, not a clean buy.
history.rating_rationale: The discount (16% below $2,144 median) and Dakota MRT/Old Airport Road lifestyle pull are real positives, and 5.3% resale CAGR on 144 txns is solid mid-pack. But multiple resident reviews cite unbearable F-15/F-16/C-130 military jet noise from Paya Lebar Airbase (weekday + Saturday daytime) and poor build quality — thin floor slabs, wall cracks. These are exactly the qualitative risks the data can't price and they directly weigh on tenant retention and resale. Airbase relocation is a long-dated catalyst (post-2030), not near-term.
red_flags: Paya Lebar Airbase military jet noise reported as severe by residents (daytime weekdays + Saturdays)
Reported poor build quality: wall cracks and thin inter-floor insulation
$1,795 psf is high in absolute terms for a 752 sqft 99LH unit despite the median discount
catalysts: 500m to Dakota MRT (Circle Line) plus Old Airport Road food/lifestyle belt
Airbase relocation (post-2030) would eventually remove the noise overhang

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Decent tenant demand from CCL connectivity and the Old Airport Road lifestyle draw, but jet noise is a known tenant deterrent that can lengthen vacancy and compress achievable rent.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: 5.3% resale CAGR is respectable; the median discount gives some cushion, but the noise/build reputation likely keeps this trailing cleaner D14/D15 RCR peers until the airbase moves.

history.summary: UOL-built D14 Dakota 3BR (1,281sqft) at $2.9M / $2,264psf — ~5.6% above URA median ($2,144), in the thin >$2.5M band, with documented military-jet noise from nearby Paya Lebar Airbase. Quality developer and MRT proximity, but priced rich with a real noise overhang.
history.rating_rationale: Genuine positives: UOL is a top-tier developer, 500m to Dakota CC8, 144 URA txns = liquid base, central D14. But the case weakens on three fronts: (1) asking $2,264psf is ~5.6% over the $2,144 median; (2) at $2.9M it's above the liquid sweet spot, thinning exit demand; (3) reviews specifically and repeatedly flag loud military jet noise (8am-9pm weekdays/Sat) from Paya Lebar Airbase — a tenant/resale negative the data can't capture. Appreciation is the weakest in the batch at 5.28%/yr. MMR 559 is only modestly above market-typical. The Paya Lebar airbase relocation (post-2030) is a long-dated catalyst that could eventually remove the noise, but that's beyond the 5-7yr horizon. Net: fully-priced with a noise discount needed — Neutral leaning cautious.
red_flags: Documented loud military-jet noise (Paya Lebar Airbase) — reviewers call it 'unbearable'
Asking ~5.6% above URA median and above the $2.5M liquid band
Lowest appreciation in batch (5.28%/yr); some reviews cite cramped grounds/maintenance
catalysts: UOL developer (strong build quality) and 500m to Dakota MRT
Paya Lebar Airbase relocation (long-dated, ~2030+) could remove jet noise eventually
